issues.feedback: The spec says original issue title must be used when refinement is disabled or fails, but implementation details only define extraction on failure and still show `unwrap_or_else(|| format!("ralph: {}", task.task_id))`. Define exact behavior for both disabled and failure paths, including when `refined_title` is set.

Constraint says body rewrite behavior must remain intact, but the proposed parser fallback (`first line as title, rest as body`) can alter/drop the first line of refined body when delimiter is missing. Specify a fallback that preserves existing body behavior (or explicitly accept this as a behavior change).

Title length policy is inconsistent (`~80` in prompt vs `<=120` validation), and tests mention 'truncates or errors'. Choose one deterministic rule (reject vs truncate) and make acceptance criteria/tests match it.

Spec only adds unit tests. Per project guidance, new behavior should include validate conformance coverage. Add daemon validate tests that assert PR creation uses refined title, fallback uses original issue title when refinement is disabled/fails, and refined-prompt comments include title+body cohesively.

Behavior for existing tasks without `refined_title` is underspecified. Decide whether PR titles for legacy tasks should derive from `raw_idea`, keep `ralph: {task_id}`, or be backfilled on dispatch, and encode this in acceptance criteria.
